description:
Mark an open promise kept or broken with an optional KVKK-safe note — makes the sales demo writable, not read-only. ≤60/hour/key → 429.

POST /v1/pbx/promises/close {promise_id, status:kept|broken, note?}. Phones/emails in note are scrubbed. Scoped by x-temsor-pbx-key when set. Idle $0 — no LLM/PSTN.

note.description: Optional short operator note. Phones/emails stripped (KVKK-safe).

promise_id.description: Promise id (prm_*). Sales demo marks open promises kept|broken.

status.description: Close outcome: kept (honoured) or broken (not kept).

name: pbx_promises_close
title: PBX Close Promise
